title: Eliminate or formally contain the ignored RSA Marvin timing advisory
description:
## Finding

A known timing side-channel advisory is globally ignored. Current local-only use lowers exposure but the policy cannot prove that affected RSA private operations never cross a hostile timing boundary, and future feature growth can silently expand exposure.

## Evidence at audited commit

`deny.toml:18` ignores `RUSTSEC-2023-0071` for the RSA dependency used by local JWT/credential paths.

## Implementation constraints

Prefer replacing/upgrading the affected primitive. If no patched compatible release exists, narrow the exception to proven non-secret/non-attacker-observable use and add a removal trigger.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Dependency reachability and every affected RSA operation are documented from call sites to trust boundary.
- [ ] A patched/replacement implementation is adopted, or a time-bounded risk acceptance proves no hostile timing oracle/private-key exposure.
- [ ] The advisory exception is package/version scoped with owner, expiry/review trigger, and explanatory link.
- [ ] Tests prevent affected code from being enabled on remote/untrusted request paths without revisiting the policy.
- [ ] `cargo audit`/`cargo deny` and credential/JWT tests pass with the new disposition.
